data_manifest.source: existing local SERAPH PostgreSQL; read-only repeatable-read
data_manifest.market_definition: equal-weight average log return of available point-in-time universe members; research index, not an executable portfolio
data_manifest.return_correction: lag computed before universe filter; only consecutive global sessions admitted; re-entry gaps not mistaken for daily returns
data_manifest.factors: ten deterministic MD5 symbol buckets of the contemporaneous eligible universe; fixed grouping rule, not sectors or licensed indices
limitations: underlying adjusted EOD2 snapshot is not an as-first-published vintage archive
source universe construction inherited; turnover proxy and survivorship coverage caveats remain
persisted original pillars retain prior research-selection history

events.provenance: Lehman Brothers bankruptcy; the global transmission date. Alternative: 2008-01-21, the Indian market's own crash, which precedes the global event by eight months and would test a different phenomenon.
Bernanke's taper testimony; the trigger for the emerging-market outflow episode that hit the rupee and Indian equities.
IL&FS default cascade and the single-day NBFC selloff; the domestic shadow-banking shock.
Onset of the global COVID selloff, chosen so the 30-day window covers the drawdown. Alternative: 2020-03-23, the Indian market bottom, which would place the window over the recovery instead.
Start of the 2022 global tightening drawdown. Alternative: 2022-06-16, the peak-hawkishness repricing.

PROVISIONAL - SPEC OQ3 is explicitly open. Placeholder for the Feb-2026 interim framework; the 50% peak and the solar CVD single-day drop are the other candidates. MUST be resolved before Epoch 6 results are reported.

vs_baseline_brier.caveat: descriptive; not adjusted for model/research selection or nonstationarity

limitations: Retrospective research: COVID and the other events informed project design. This is not an untouched pre-COVID model or prospective validation.
Underlying adjusted prices are a current snapshot, not an as-first-published vintage archive. Universe/survivorship and turnover-proxy caveats are inherited.
The market series is an equal-weight geometric-return research index of available universe members, not a tradable portfolio or the NIFTY index.
All project event dates are provisional; tariff-2026 is explicitly unresolved. Warnings against that placeholder are diagnostic only.
New daily-tail Hawkes and 10 hash-portfolio RMT are distinct from original intraday/500-stock estimators; no high-dimensional RMT significance claim is made.
Hamilton next-crisis-state probability denotes a fitted high-volatility latent state, not the probability of a named crisis.
Only six labelled episodes exist; overlapping daily positives do not create six independent years of crises. Sampling and regime uncertainty remain substantial.
Threshold budgets are fit on past data and may be violated subsequently. Abstention, missingness, and unassessable early periods are retained.
Bootstrap intervals do not correct for research/model selection, changing regimes, data revisions or label uncertainty.
HMM cap-limited and Hawkes sparse-event fits remain visible in fit_audit.json; forecasts contain model uncertainty not captured by simulation standard errors.
No broker execution, production monitoring, point-in-time news/macro ingestion, or production acceptance is claimed.

empirical_acceptance.reason: Retrospective replay does not establish dependable advance crisis prediction; inspect measured results and retain failed hypotheses.
